hints.title: Prefix Constraint Propagation
hints.text: When choosing the i-th word of the square, its prefix must match the characters already placed in the i-th column.

hints.title: Lookup Table by Prefix
hints.text: Index all input words by their prefixes of lengths 1 through k for quick lookup.

hints.title: Recursive Backtracking
hints.text: Recursively construct word squares row by row, pruning candidates that do not match the required column prefix.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Here N is the number of words and L is word length.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all permutations of words takes O(N^L) which is prohibitive without prefix pruning.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Prefix dictionary requires O(N * L) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects prefix tree or hash map pruning during backtracking.
